verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork page invites users to "Describe your control" and has AI agents collect and validate the evidence for it. The framework-removal docs mention controls that hold "custom content" and evidence. Together these thinly suggest user-described controls with evidence collection alongside built-in frameworks. missing for 10: any evidence of creating custom frameworks, explicit documentation of creating custom controls, user-defined tests/monitors, configurable evidence requirements, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can add custom frameworks and custom controls with my own tests and evidence requirements alongside the built-in ones

citations.quote: Describe your control. Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
Controls stay when another framework requires them or when they contain work such as evidence, review history, assignments, or custom content.
